# Content report

**Generated by `python3 tools/content-report.py --write`. Do not edit by hand.**

The specification asks for an admin dashboard carrying these numbers. An admin
dashboard needs authentication, a backend and somebody logged in. This build has
none of those, so the same figures are computed at build time and committed —
which has one advantage a dashboard does not: the gaps show up in a diff.

## Against the specification's own targets

| | now | MVP target (§67) | year one (§92) | |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Countries | 50 | 5 | 10 | met |
| Travel regions | 130 | 50 | — | met |
| Destinations | 319 | 150 | 300 | met |
| Places | 255 | 1000 | 3000 | 26% of MVP |
| Experiences | 197 | 300 | 1000 | 66% of MVP |
| Journeys | 17 | 50 | 100 | 34% of MVP |
| Stories | 9 | 100 | 500 | 9% of MVP |
| Business listings | 8 | 500 | 2000 | 2% of MVP |

Two of those gaps are deliberate rather than pending. **Business listings** will
not be filled by seeding: a directory of businesses that have not claimed their
entry and cannot be verified is the exact thing this project refuses to publish,
so that number stays at the illustrative records until operators can claim one.
**Stories** and **journeys** are editorial work at roughly a day each, and the
honest position is that they are behind rather than automatable.

## Interface translation

| language | coverage | ships |
|---|---:|---|
| en | 100% | yes |
| fr | 29% | held |

A catalogue ships at 100% of the interface **and** localised destination copy.
A half-translated site is worse than an English one.
